text:
marta: Follow-up from last night's KV eviction postmortem. Need owners and short timelines for the test/evals work so we don't lose momentum. I propose three items: regression pack, prompt bank, and a soak+micro-chaos runbook. Quick volunteers?
leo: I can do the regression pack. Will create ~30 scenario templates (prefix overlap, history trim, rapid switch). Repro runner + seeds. ETA 10 days.
jen: I'll curate the prompt bank (~180 prompts). Tag by sensitivity/model/seed and include expected behavior notes. ETA 7 days.
harry: Ops will run the soak + micro-chaos and author the runbook. Plan: staging dry run next Wed. I'll add dashboards and rollback checklist.
marta: Add measurable success criteria please. For soak: 20-30m at 1.2x prod 99th, 10s synthetic spike. Pass if fallback <1%, 95p latency delta <25%, KV miss multiplier <4x.
leo: CI plan: small presubmit subset for PRs touching kv/cache/router, sampled nightly (small+med), full sweep weekly. Presubmit run <90s.
jen: I'll tag top-40 high-sensitivity prompts to run in weekly sweeps; others nightly. Include expected outputs to reduce triage noise.
marta: ops-bot, create the tasks and set recurrences: weekly regression review (owner: leo) and quarterly chaos run (owner: harry). Link to postmortem.
ops-bot: Created tasks: EV-110 (regressions) owner: leo due: 2026-04-10; EV-111 (prompt bank) owner: jen due: 2026-04-07; EV-112 (soak+runbook) owner: harry due: 2026-04-08. Recurrences added. Links: https://tasks.internal/EV-110 https://tasks.internal/EV-111 https://tasks.internal/EV-112
harry: Dry run scheduled Wed 2026-04-01 09:00 PT. Invites sent.
marta: Final ask: gate PRs touching KV-sensitive paths with the tiny presubmit subset. Leo, can you add matcher globs?
leo: Yes — matcher: paths: ["src/serving/kv/**","libs/cache/**","src/router/**"]. Will add PR tomorrow.
marta: Great. We'll reconvene after dry run to confirm thresholds and cadence. :white_check_mark:
